THE_RULE.verbatim: 4v4/6v6 are additive external-validity results. They are not allowed to delay or destabilize the completed 2v2 paper package.
THE_RULE.consequence: if certification or the scaled distillation audit discovers another rabbit hole, STOP there and keep writing. The 2v2 package ships regardless.

local_pc: 2v2 deployment robustness: localization noise, motion error, control delay
COMPUTE_SEPARATION.why_separable: the 2v2 robustness work needs the local GPU and no new training; the scaled work needs long PPO runs and no local GPU.
COMPUTE_SEPARATION.OBSERVED_CONTENTION_CAVEAT: sealed GPU evaluation in this project is bottlenecked by CPU env stepping, not GPU inference. A CPU-side job (e.g. the strategic-demand certification) therefore DOES contend with a running GPU eval: with the Rung 3 eval in flight the 4v4 certification ran far slower than its 54 s/seed solo probe. Separation is by device only in a loose sense; schedule accordingly.

SCHOOL_PC_GREEN_LIGHT_REQUIRES_ALL_THREE: specialist A and B PPO smokes PASS at that size
the scaled distillation path is audited AND smoke-passes at that size
enforcement: experiments/train_specialist_scale.py already refuses production training for any size whose certification is missing or not CERTIFIED. The gate was tested and fires.

generic_already.rl/teacher_distillation.py: derives n_agents from decision_mask.shape[1] and validates n_heads % n_agents; no hard-coded team size
generic_already.rl/causal_supervision.py: decision_mask_from_core takes n_agents and ASSERTS the live tick tensor matches, raising CausalRoutingError otherwise

module constant N_AGENTS = 2, passed to decision_mask_from_core
needs_parameterizing.experiments/r2_learned_crossover.py: build_env uses its own module-level AGENTS

SCALED_DISTILLATION_AUDIT_RESULT.NAMING_TRAP_RECORDED: the collector's constant is named N_AGENTS, not AGENTS, so train_scale.py's _propagate_team_size sweep -- which looks for an attribute literally named AGENTS -- does NOT catch it. A scaled distillation wrapper must set it explicitly. The failure mode is LOUD (the decision_mask_from_core assertion fires on the shape mismatch) rather than a silent mistrain, but the sweep must not be trusted to cover it.
SCALED_DISTILLATION_AUDIT_RESULT.verdict: BOUNDED, NOT A RABBIT HOLE. The distillation core is already team-size generic; the work is one constant plus an env-builder global, wrapped the same way train_specialist_scale.py wraps the specialist path.

WHAT_IS_NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_RECORD: production specialist training at any size
any change to the 2v2 poles, probes, checkpoints or results
deployment robustness at 4v4 or 6v6 (those sizes have no frozen latent policy)
